tariff.label: Electricity tariff
tariff.note: Slab rates are from the BERC June 2026 order after the 0-75 unit rollback. VAT and demand charge are NOT confirmed here: check a recent bill and set them below.

roof.label: Roof and panel sizing
roof.note: Placeholder values. Confirm roof area per kW and usable roof share with your installer or panel datasheet.

costs.label: Equipment costs
costs.note: Placeholder prices, not quotations. Replace with real installer quotes (payback depends heavily on them).

battery.label: Battery assumptions
battery.note: Typical placeholder values. Check the battery and inverter datasheets.

pvgis.label: PVGIS solar data settings
pvgis.note: Yield is fetched live from PVGIS. angle_degrees and aspect_degrees are null, so PVGIS defaults apply: set them (or use_optimal_angles) to match the real roof.

sizing.label: System sizing target
sizing.note: Design choice: share of average consumption the system is sized to offset.
